title: 5 C's of Marketing | Sydney Marketing Agency | Brafton

facts.fact: The Brafton article 'The 5 C's of Marketing, Explained' is dated September 05, 2025.
Brafton describes the 5 Cs of marketing as a situation analysis framework with five terms: company, customers, competitors, collaborators and climate.
facts.quote: this mnemonic consists of five terms: company, customers, competitors, collaborators and climate.

facts.fact: Brafton says a defined marketing plan often includes instructions to review the 5 Cs at regular intervals, such as every six months or on an annual basis.
facts.quote: such as every six months or on an annual basis

facts.fact: Brafton notes that some 5C adherents rank 'capabilities' among the elements of their analysis, but Brafton treats that term as largely synonymous with the 'company' category.
facts.quote: we’ll view that term as being largely synonymous with the “company” category.
